stock.name: Square sail
stock.does: As built: best on a reach

lateen.name: Lateen sail
lateen.does: Points higher into the wind; slower running before it

spinnaker.name: Spinnaker
spinnaker.does: Flies downwind; useless close to it

storm.name: Storm sail
storm.does: Strong in a gale, weak in light airs

krakenSail.name: Kraken sail
krakenSail.does: Draws in light airs; spills a strong wind

worldSail.name: Jormungandr sail
worldSail.does: Points high and runs well; starves in light airs

shallow.name: Shallow keel
shallow.does: Turns fast; currents push it more

serpentKeel.name: Sea serpent keel
serpentKeel.does: Turns fast and tracks a current; a little slower

scaled.name: Scaled hull
scaled.does: Bears one more hit; a little slower

akhlutHull.name: Akhlut hull
akhlutHull.does: The fastest hull; bears one hit fewer and turns slower

monkHull.name: Umibozu hull
monkHull.does: Bears two hits more; heavy and slow
